status: Reusable future repair prompts, not generation claims. The current fix uses canonical body landmarks and technical masks with the existing paintings.
body_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the {family} garment master. Reference: the approved {body} painted character in the supplied canonical S, SW, W, NW, N, NE, E, SE views. Tailor this garment naturally around the actual shoulders, neck opening, waist and arms. Preserve the approved identity, body proportions, warm pencil outlines, matte watercolor/gouache grain, soft folds and restrained cream/sage/lavender/leather/brass palette. Collar sits under the chin, cuffs wrap the arms, a curved hem follows the waist. Use body landmarks, never the centre of a tail/wing bounding box. Keep tails, wings, ears and braids clear. Ghosts wear open-sided wraps and hem bands, without human legs. Return isolated transparent garment pigment in the same canonical canvas and pose; do not include skin, hands, hair, underclothing, face, background, white sticker border or cast shadow. Preserve the garment design and all other slots. Do not rescale a full outfit as one piece.
hat_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: {hat} for the approved {body} character. Keep the elevated isometric camera and each canonical directional view. Seat the hat brim around the actual head and hair volume, with natural material thickness, overlap and soft contact shading. Preserve ear openings, buns, braids and the face; match warm fine pencil edges and matte painted grain. Return only the complete hat on true transparency, aligned to the original 256x256 body canvas with ground anchor 128,200. No head, hair, body, clothing, background or sticker rim. Keep every other slot unchanged.
shoe_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: {shoes} for the approved {body} character. Fit each foot independently in the supplied eight body views: cuffs meet ankles, soles sit on the ground plane, far/near foot perspective and spacing match the character. Preserve matte honey/bark leather or the original cloth/wood material, subtle folds, warm pencil edges and watercolor grain. Hobbits use ankle wraps with visible toes; ghosts use paired hem tabs/charms without human feet. Return only the pair, correctly aligned on the unchanged transparent 256x256 body canvas and 128,200 ground anchor. No body parts, trousers, scenery, white outline or cast shadow. Shoe selection must not alter hat or body clothing.
